recordings.title: ferrari355underhood4.mp3
recordings.author: enginemusic
recordings.provenance: Recorded in 1997 inside a Ferrari 355 Spider engine compartment with Core Sound binaural microphones and Sony D8 DAT; one microphone by intake and one by valve cover. Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original master.
recordings.adaptation: Mono 24 kHz PCM, 65 Hz high-pass / 5.8 kHz low-pass, selected source intervals, cosine loop overlap, DC/seam correction and peak/RMS normalization. In-game pitch, RPM blend and load EQ are authored, not measured.
recordings.use: Adapted proxy texture blended with original synthesis; not a recording of the represented game model.
